input.title: A Light in the Attic
input.description: It's hard to imagine a world without A Light in the Attic. This now-classic collection of poetry and drawings from Shel Silverstein celebrates its 20th anniversary with this special edition.

input.title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
input.description: From a renowned historian comes a groundbreaking narrative of humanity's creation and evolution, a number one international bestseller that explores the ways in which biology and history have defined us.

input.title: Sharp Objects
input.description: WICKED above her hipbone, GIRL across her heart. Words are like a road map to reporter Camille Preaker's troubled past. Fresh from a brief stay at a psychiatric hospital, she returns to her hometown to cover a gruesome story.

input.title: The Boys in the Boat: Nine Americans and Their Epic Quest for Gold at the 1936 Berlin Olympics
input.description: For readers of Laura Hillenbrand's Seabiscuit and Unbroken, the dramatic true story of the American rowing team that stunned the world at Hitler's 1936 Berlin Olympics.

input.title: You can't bury them all: Poems
input.description: A poetry collection that is at once harrowing, angry, and achingly beautiful. Patrick Woodcock has spent the past seven years engaging with and being shaped by the harsh realities he writes about.

input.title: The Bear and the Piano
input.description: One day, a young bear stumbles upon something he has never seen before in the forest. As time passes, he teaches himself how to play the strange instrument, a picture book for young readers.

input.title: Reasons to Stay Alive
